text:
maria: Opening a short PR to consolidate SOC2 audit-log guidance and add a compact migration guide for audit_schema v2. Need tiny SDK snippets (Go/Node/Python), one export JSON example including the new fields, and legal-approved retention wording before the release cut. Please chime in.

sanjay: I'll draft a migration map (old_field -> new_field) and include a curl + python example for export. Also add a redirect for old docs links.

alex: I can do Go and Node snippets and a jq sanity-check for the export example. Will keep examples minimal.

jen: Legal preference for wording (please use exactly): "Customer account retention is configurable; the default retention period is 90 days. Exported audit records will be retained only when required by applicable law or legal process." Also, replace any use of "customer" with "customer account" to match the glossary.

docs-bot: PR #5077 opened by maria: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/5077 :sparkles:

sanjay: Will push short migration table and the jq line: `jq '.items[] | {ts: .timestamp, cat: .audit_event.category, svc: .service.context.name, legal: .metadata.legal_hold}' export.json`

maria: Thanks all — plan: merge after QA + legal sign-off and coordinate infra on the export format change.
